input-field.name: jwtPrivateKeyPem
input-field.label: JWT Private Key (PEM)
input-field.helpText: Paste the PRIVATE key contents (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- ...)

input-field.name: apiVersion
input-field.label: Salesforce API Version
input-field.helpText: e.g. v60.0 — leave empty to use the default (v60.0)

input-field.name: conflictResolution
input-field.label: Conflict Resolution
input-field.helpText: Shopware wins: always push Shopware data to Salesforce. Salesforce wins: only create new Contacts, never overwrite existing SF data.

name.en-GB: Shopware wins (always sync from Shopware → Salesforce)
name.de-DE: Shopware gewinnt (immer von Shopware → Salesforce synchronisieren)

name.en-GB: Salesforce wins (only create new Contacts, skip existing)
name.de-DE: Salesforce gewinnt (nur neue Kontakte erstellen, vorhandene überspringen)

input-field.name: inboundPollEnabled
input-field.label: Enable Salesforce → Shopware polling sync
Salesforce → Shopware Polling-Sync aktivieren
input-field.helpText: When enabled, the plugin polls Salesforce every 15 minutes for recently changed Contacts and updates the matching Shopware customers.

input-field.name: fieldMapping
input-field.label: Customer → Contact field mapping (JSON)
input-field.helpText: Advanced: override the default field mapping as a JSON object, e.g. {"email":"Email","firstName":"FirstName"}. Use the visual editor in the plugin config page instead.

input-field.name: orderSyncEnabled
input-field.label: Enable automatic order sync (scheduled)
Automatische Bestellsynchronisierung aktivieren (geplant)
input-field.helpText: When enabled, all orders are automatically pushed to Salesforce as Opportunities on a daily schedule.
Wenn aktiviert, werden alle Bestellungen täglich automatisch als Opportunities zu Salesforce übertragen.

input-field.name: orderSyncStatuses
input-field.label: Order statuses to sync
Zu synchronisierende Bestellstatus
input-field.helpText: Select which order statuses to include in the sync. Leave empty to sync all statuses.
Wähle die Bestellstatus, die synchronisiert werden sollen. Leer lassen, um alle Status zu synchronisieren.
